prompts.text: Describe a picture so clearly that a teammate could draw it and get it right.
Give a description of your desk setup for a teammate to draw.
Describe the office pet (real or imaginary) in drawable detail.
Describe a famous landmark using only geometry.
Describe a character from a book as precisely as you can.
Describe a scene from your favorite movie so a teammate can draw it.
Describe your morning commute (if it's a drawing, it's interesting).
Describe the ideal team lunch spread for a drawing.
Describe a machine that turns procrastination into work.
Describe a creature that lives under your desk.
Describe a poster for the 'greatest team meeting ever'.
